html_source: Mr. Deasy’s letter to the editor.

 Airs romped round him, nipping and eager airs. They are coming, waves. The whitemaned seahorses, champing, brightwindbridled, the steeds of Mananaan. 

 I mustn't forget

. And after? The Ship, half twelve. By the way go easy with that money like a good young imbecile. Yes, I must.
